title: v6 1-minute test: I went back to school for 30 days to find the money class
note: STYLE_3D.md v6 test (owner 29 Oct 2026: 'we need just 1 min test'). Opening minute of a Dave experiment episode; every visual comes from the words of its own line (props-from-script).
sources: Dog lifespan: median life expectancy of UK dogs about 12.5 years (Teng et al. 2024, Scientific Reports 14:3421, 584,734 dogs) -> 'about as long as a dog lives' for 12 years.
The train problem and the textbook are jokes about a typical maths class, not data.

beats.text: I spent twelve years in school and they taught me how to find the area of a triangle but they spent zero minutes teaching me how to do my taxes.
And twelve years is about as long as a dog lives so a whole dog lived and died while I was learning triangles.
So I did the only reasonable thing and I went back to school.
For the next thirty days I am sitting in every single class a normal school has because I am looking for the one lesson that teaches you about money.
If I find it I win but if I don't find it I am writing that class myself and you are all taking it.
So on day one I walked into my math class.
And I was so happy because finally there were numbers and numbers are basically money right?
Well we spent fifty minutes on a train that leaves Chicago at three and not one second on the train that leaves your bank account every month which is called rent.
So I searched the whole textbook for the word interest and in four hundred pages there was zero interest which is also exactly how much I had left by page ten.
So day one gave me zero money lessons and honestly I already want to drop out.
